description: This horizontal grouped bar chart, titled “Defending Against Social Engineering Attacks in the Age of LLMs,” illustrates the distribution of conversations across four categories — Academic Collaboration, Recruitment, Academic Funding, and Journalism — based on whether participants reported being “Deceived” (Yes, Partially, or No). The horizontal axis represents the “Number of Conversations,” ranging from 0 to 60 in increments of 10. Each category has three adjacent bars: dark red for “Yes,” olive green for “Partially,” and green for “No,” as indicated by the legend in the upper right. For “Academic Collaboration,” approximately 36 conversations reported “Yes,” 27 “Partially,” and 7 “No.” In “Recruitment,” “Yes” reached about 38, “Partially” 24, and “No” 6. “Academic Funding” shows the highest “Yes” count at roughly 65, with “Partially” at 4 and “No” at 3. “Journalism” has “Yes” at 15, “Partially” at 48, and “No” at 6. The chart visually emphasizes that deception was most frequently reported in “Academic Funding,” while “Journalism” had the highest number of “Partially” deceived cases.
